rigorous_scientific_distinction: Continuous autofocus (focusMode: 'continuous') is proven by photoCapabilities and metadata.json. However, because neither Android Chrome nor the S23 Ultra camera HAL logged real-time lens position or focus distance time-series data, autofocus hunting at shutter is a PLAUSIBLE RISK, NOT PROVEN FACT. Optical softness cannot be dogmatically attributed to misfocus without hardware focus telemetry.
